text: dsh-session-topics 是面向 DSH Web 的会话标题与列表信息插件。它接入会话持久化、标题服务、默认模型和 Web 服务，在启动后扫描仍使用提示词摘录回退标题的会话，并在 agent 每轮结束回到空闲时再次尝试生成标题；生成结果作为 session/title 事件写入活动会话或持久化日志。插件还提供会话日志大小查询，并为会话列表悬浮卡片补入大小显示。适合希望标题能由模型概括、并快速查看会话记录体量的 DSH Web 用户。标题使用 DSH 当前默认模型。

dsh-session-topics generates DSH Web session titles from the first user message, retrying after startup and when an agent becomes idle. It appends titles to live or persisted sessions and patches the session hover card to show log size. It uses the current default model.
想让 DSH 根据会话里的首条用户消息自动生成更清楚的标题。
会话标题还是提示词开头的几个字，能不能在任务结束后重新概括？
Can DSH retry a generated session title after an agent finishes a turn?
dsh-session-topics 的功能「回退标题补全」：启动后延迟扫描持久化会话，并在 agent 回到 idle 时重试仍为回退标题的会话。标题由当前默认模型根据首条用户消息生成，再写入会话标题事件；已固定的用户标题不会被覆盖。
dsh-session-topics 的功能「悬浮卡片显示日志大小」：插件提供 /topics-size 查询会话日志字节数，并在 DSH Web 启动时为会话列表悬浮卡片补入大小行，按 KB 或 MB 显示。
dsh-session-topics 生成标题时会把首条用户消息（最多截取 3000 个字符）提交给 DSH 当前选择的模型；实际模型服务由 DSH 配置决定。见 index.js:101-120。

dsh-session-topics README · dsh-session-topics：[中文文档](./README.zh.md)

Session topic titles for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) — LLM-generated session titles that actually hold up, plus a hover-card size readout for the session list.

dsh-session-topics README · Why：dsh ships a title generator (`session-title-first-prompt-llm`), but it is one-shot, never retried, and its `maxOutputTokens: 64` reliably loses to reasoning models — so sessions keep the deterministic "first words of your prompt" fallback titles. This plugin retries until every session gets a real topic title, like Claude Code and Codex do.

dsh-session-topics README · Why：It never registers a title provider (the slot is sole-tenant); it appends `session/title` log events directly, which the title service folds like any other. User-renamed (pinned) titles are never touched.

dsh-session-topics README · Features：- **Startup sweep** — 8s after boot, every persisted session still on a fallback title gets an LLM-generated title (current default model) written into its log. Live sessions go through `Session.append`; cold sessions through `sessionPersistence.load` + `append`.
- **Turn-end retry** — on every agent `running → idle`, if that session's title is still the fallback, retitle it. Bundle-layer listeners cover all sessions.
- **`GET /topics-size?id=<sessionId>`** — durable log byte size, feeding the hover-card patch below.
- **`GET /topics-sweep`** — manually trigger a sweep and get per-session results as JSON (debugging).

dsh-session-topics README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-session-topics-0.3.0.tgz   # tgz attached to the latest release

dsh-session-topics README · restart dsh web：```

Reinstalling the same version is a no-op (pnpm dedupes by name+version) — bump the version before repacking.

dsh-session-topics README · Hover-card size patch (self-healing)：The session-list hover card belongs to the shipped `dsh-client-ui-workspace` bundle and exposes no plugin slot, so the size line is a source patch. **Since 0.3.0 the plugin re-applies it automatically at every boot** — including after dsh upgrades rematerialize the shared layer. No manual step. (Shared-layer files are pnpm store hardlinks, so the patch is written delete-then-rewrite.)

A manual entry point remains for machines without the plugin:

dsh-session-topics README · Hover-card size patch (self-healing)：```powershell
node scripts/patch-hover-size.mjs
```

- Idempotent; exits loudly without touching anything if the anchors drift (new dsh version).
- The size line stays hidden when this plugin is not running.
dsh-session-topics README · Verified：dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, web profile: 8 existing sessions retitled end-to-end (live `append` + cold persistence `append`), hover size served and rendered.
